channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: 2026 Thought Leaders Retreat heads to Texas in July
item.description: TLR takes place July 27–29 in Arlington, Texas at Live by Loews overlooking AT&T Stadium.

item.title: Landscape Workshop debuts Shared Prosperity Plan for full-time employees
item.description: The program was developed in partnership with Ownership Works, a nonprofit that helps companies and investors launch broad-based employee ownership programs.

item.title: Cetane Associates adds Grant Su as analyst
item.description: Su assists in the due diligence and closing process through data organization and information analysis.

item.title: Weber Environmental Services integrates into Continuum Services brand
item.description: Since acquiring Weber Environmental Services in May 2023, Continuum's Florida team has grown from 90 to more than 125 employees.

item.title: Ruppert Landscape opens landscape maintenance branch in Houston
item.description: Ruppert has been active in the Houston market since 2012.

item.title: Blue Diamond Attachments debuts HDX Rock Grapple Bucket
item.description: At 72 inches wide and 39 inches deep, the HDX Rock Grapple Bucket offers a maximum opening of 32 inches.

item.title: Riverview Landscapes acquires Unisource Commercial Landscape in Massachusetts
item.description: As part of the transaction, Unisource’s commercial landscaping and cleaning operations will combine to form Riverview’s new Boston Metro West branch.

item.title: SDLG North America to showcase new electric, diesel UTVs
item.description: The company will showcase the UTVs at CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026, held this week in Las Vegas.

item.title: WAC Lighting founder earns Long Island Business News Icon Award
item.description: The winners will be recognized at a celebration on March 19.

item.title: New Holland Construction expands D-Series range with 5 new diesel mini excavators
item.description: These join the previously released E42D and E50D models from 2025.
